title: scenarios: ask mode can give the client a skills directory; dataset scenario cards with graders for metric-selected, asked-back and fallback-labelled
body:
epic:#34659#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnXJdSZifpEN5i7aU

Filing gate: ④ a child of the cross-lane parent #34659 (the 「MCP 二期与问数」 epic), filed on the maintainer's word in this seat's chat, 2026-11-17, verbatim: 「同意你的所有建议，开始立专题子卡」. The ruling record is #34659 comment 6940528935.

## Why

The 问数 path through governed metrics is not measured at all: no open scenario card declares a dataset, and the ask client cannot be given a skill. Two rulings now rest on a measurement the runner cannot make: the published ask-data skill (D5, D7), and E2, which stays at exact matching only while a skill-only ask-back branch works.

Who acts: the devx lane (`packages/qa/scenarios`, `docs/qa/scenarios`). Who reads the result: the eval seat each round, and the maintainer on E2.

## Evidence (objectstack `a0326b06`, read 2026-11-17)

- `ls docs/qa/scenarios/*.json` is 9 cards; `grep -l -i "dataset\|synonym"` over them matches none.
- The ask client is an empty temporary directory with `--strict-mcp-config --allowedTools mcp__app` (`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/driver.ts:468-483`). The authoring client does get `Skill` (`:456`).
- A project skill placed in the client's directory is discovered by `claude -p` with no extra flag once `Skill` is allowed (this seat's pilot, 12 of 12 runs listed it).

## Scope (ruled D6 = A)

- An opt-in runner option that places a named skills directory in the ask client's working directory and allows the `Skill` tool. Off by default, so existing records stay comparable. The record states which skills, at which version, the ask client had.
- Two or three open cards extended with datasets that declare synonyms and member descriptions, an ambiguous pair (one word, two members), a near-miss word and a question no dataset covers.
- Three graders, mechanical where the transcript allows: `metric-selected` (the answer came through `query_dataset` with the expected measure), `asked-back` (the answer asks which reading is meant and states no figure), `fallback-labelled` (an object-query answer says it is not from a governed metric).
- Borrow the cloud question kinds, not the cloud fixture.
- File surface: `packages/qa/scenarios/**`, `docs/qa/scenarios/**`.

## Done when

- One ask round at five repetitions per configuration, with and without the skills directory, is on record as an `eval-run`.
- That record answers the E2 premise in words the ruling uses: does the client ask back on a near-miss word with the skill, and does the skill cause any ask-back on a question with exactly one match.

## Out of scope

- A schedule for the round (the eval lane's).
- A build-over-draft-door mode: a later milestone.

## Relations

- Parent: #34659. Blocked by nothing; the skill text the pilot used is on the sibling skills card.
- Dedup, open and closed: `scenario card dataset grader in:title` 0; `scenario runner ask skills directory flag` 1 hit, #9417 (closed), a QA run record, not this.
